name: Winterwandern am Sonnenterrasse Seefeld
beschreibung:
### Überblick
The Seefeld plateau at 1,200 meters elevation is widely regarded as the premier winter-walking destination in the Alps. Boasting more than 140 kilometers of freshly plowed, groomed snow paths nestled between the Wetterstein and Karwendel ranges, it offers pristine mountain tranquility. The circuit to the 1,493-meter Brunschkopf summit and the Wildmoos plateau is one of the region's crown jewels. Snow-draped pine forests lead up to a modern 360-degree viewing platform equipped with a Swarovski Optik telescope, revealing panoramic vistas of the Hohe Munde, Zugspitze, and Karwendel peaks.

### Route & Anforderungen
The walk begins at the iconic Seekirchl chapel on the western edge of Seefeld. The well-compacted trail climbs steadily along scenic woodland avenues past Lake Möserer See to the summit of Brunschkopf (1,493 m), returning via the rolling meadows of Wildmoos and the historic Wildmoosalm. Spanning 9 to 10 kilometers with an easy 320 meters of elevation change, the hike takes 2.5 to 3 hours. Suitable for active families and seniors. Sturdy waterproof winter hiking boots are essential; lightweight traction spikes (microspikes) and trekking poles are recommended on hardpack sections. Leashed dogs are welcome.

### Anreise
Seefeld features the highest ICE-served railway station in the world, directly connected with hourly high-speed and regional rail links from Innsbruck, Munich, and Garmisch. From the train station, the trail begins within minutes at Seekirchl. Drivers arrive via the B177 road from Innsbruck or via Mittenwald, with paid parking available near the WM Halle and Seekirchl.

### Tipps
Plan a warm mid-walk stop on the sheltered sun terrace of Wildmoosalm, famous for oven-fresh apple strudel, Kaiserschmarrn, and regional hospitality. An early morning departure captures brilliant low-angle sunbeams across frosted alpine meadows. Holders of the regional guest card can board local winter shuttle buses to and from Wildmoos free of charge.
